title: Webhook payload read into memory without a size cap

pr_metadata.title: Allow large webhook payloads
pr_metadata.body: Bulk imports send big bodies; remove the cap.

labels.defect: Unbounded stream read: a single request can exhaust worker memory
labels.evidence: Reproducible: a 10 GiB streamed body is read fully into RAM per request; a handful of concurrent requests OOM the worker pool. The old cap rejected abuse deterministically.

rights.origin: original synthetic fixture authored for this corpus (repository MIT)
rights.egress: synthetic; no real secrets, hosts, or user data
